author: The Current
description:
Ishmael Butler of Shabazz Palaces talks about covering Prince on new "Maximum MN" compilation for Sub Pop 
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Seattle-based record label Sub Pop — home to Duluth’s Alan Sparhawk and Low, as well as Father John Misty, Beach House, and many others — has announced a new mutual aid compilation, Maximum MN.

Out Friday, Sept. 4, exclusively as part of Bandcamp Friday, the eight-track digital mixtape features artists on the Sub Pop roster covering classic songs by Minnesota artists, such as Prince, Hippo Campus, the Replacements, and more. Championed by Sub Pop’s social media manager and a host on Seattle radio station KEXP, Abbie Gobeli (who graduated from the University of Minnesota), the goal was to create a benefit compilation to help out Minnesota families affected by recent ICE operations.
